# Popover

## Popover

### Decisions

`requires_parent`: PopoverContent must be composed inside Popover; the reference draws the content only inside an open parent.

`no_reference`: the reference draws this member only inside an open parent, so it is measured through that parent's samples.

- `open` is caller-owned, as upstream's; the component asks the caller to close through `onRequestClose` on Escape and outside press.
- The caret lifts the surface half its height off the anchor (`offset + caretHeight / 2`), the reference's own `calc`.
- The inverse (`highContrast`) surface reads the `tooltip_*` cells and draws neither shadow nor border, as the reference's high-contrast popover does.

### Platform

Both platforms draw the same box; the layer mounts `fixed` on the web and `absolute` inside the overlay host on a native platform.

PopoverContent is measured through Popover's samples; the reference draws it only inside an open Popover.

## Popover

Popover anchors a floating surface with an optional caret to its trigger and leaves its open state to the caller.

| | |
|---|---|
| Tier | `molecule` |
| Platform | `touch_degraded` - fallback: opens on press without hover |
| Reference | `render-web` (`@carbon/react`) |
| Enums | none |
| Behaviors | `overlay`, `anchored-position` |
| Flags | none |

### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `open` | `boolean` | yes | The open state; the caller owns it. |
| `onRequestClose` | `function` | no | Called on Escape and on an outside press while open. |
| `align` | `string` | no | The side and alignment the surface opens on: `top`, `top-start`, `top-end`, `bottom`, `bottom-start`, `bottom-end`, `left`, `left-start`, `left-end`, `right`, `right-start`, `right-end`. Default `bottom`. |
| `autoAlign` | `boolean` | no | Flips the placement at the viewport edge. |
| `caret` | `boolean` | no | Draws the caret on the anchor-facing edge. Default true. |
| `dropShadow` | `boolean` | no | Draws the surface's drop shadow. Default true; the inverse surface never draws one. |
| `border` | `boolean` | no | Draws the 1px `popover_border` outline. Default false. |
| `highContrast` | `boolean` | no | Draws the inverse surface from the `tooltip` cells: no shadow, no border. |
| `content` | `node` | no | The popover body; a string wraps into the theme's default text in the `popover_label` ink. |
| `children` | `node` | yes | The anchor the surface is placed beside; a string wraps into the theme's default text. |
| `testID` | `string` | no | Test identifier forwarded to the anchor wrapper. |

### Metrics

| Metric | Rule |
|---|---|
| `radius` | `control.popover_radius` |
| `caretWidth` | `control.popover_caret_width` |
| `caretHeight` | `control.popover_caret_height` |
| `offset` | `control.popover_offset` |
| `maxWidth` | `control.popover_max_width` |
| `level` | `stacking.floating` |

### States (sample.js)

| State | Props |
|---|---|
| default | `{"open":true,"content":"Popover content","children":"Anchor"}` |
| caret-off | `{"open":true,"caret":false,"content":"Popover content","children":"Anchor"}` |
| border | `{"open":true,"border":true,"content":"Popover content","children":"Anchor"}` |
| high-contrast | `{"open":true,"highContrast":true,"content":"Popover content","children":"Anchor"}` |
| top | `{"open":true,"align":"top","content":"Popover content","children":"Anchor"}` |
| no-shadow | `{"open":true,"dropShadow":false,"content":"Popover content","children":"Anchor"}` |

## PopoverContent

PopoverContent is the floating body of a Popover; it must be composed inside Popover; it has no upstream visual reference because upstream draws it only inside an open parent, so it is measured through the parent's samples.

| | |
|---|---|
| Tier | `molecule` |
| Platform | `both` |
| Reference | `none` (`@carbon/react`) |
| Enums | none |
| Behaviors | `overlay`, `anchored-position` |
| Flags | `requires_parent` - renders only inside its parent; `no_reference` - no upstream visual reference; gates are structural, accessibility and cross-template |

### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` | `node` | no | The bubble's body; a string wraps into the theme's default text in the surface's ink. |
| `testID` | `string` | no | Test identifier forwarded to the bubble. |

### Metrics

| Metric | Rule |
|---|---|
| `radius` | `control.popover_radius` |
| `caretWidth` | `control.popover_caret_width` |
| `caretHeight` | `control.popover_caret_height` |
| `maxWidth` | `control.popover_max_width` |

### States (sample.js)

| State | Props |
|---|---|
| default | `{"children":"Popover content"}` |
